content.title: The Self-Taught Engineer Going Head-to-Head With Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos
content.summary: ​WALLOPS ISLAND, Va.—The newly constructed  Rocket Lab  launchpad on Virginia’s Atlantic coast needs to be able to withstand 1.5 million pounds of thrust.  Peter Beck,  the company’s founder and chief executive, had another requirement: It had to look beautiful.  A self-taught engineer from a remote part of New Zealand, he has been the driving force behind Rocket Lab’s growth as a launch-and-satellite company.

content.title: AI, robotics, & space market boom: How to profit
content.description:
Listen and subscribe to Stocks In Translation on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or wherever you find your favorite podcast.

Rockets, robots, and artificial intelligence (AI) chips are rewriting the market playbook.

In this episode of Stocks in Translation, HitTheBid.com owner Kenny Glick joins host Jared Blikre and producer Sydnee Fried to discuss risks in today's market. Glick suggests the biggest risks for traders are becoming overly complacent and not making moves in this bullish market.

He also provides insight on stocks to watch as the world enters a new tech-driven industrial revolution: Rigetti Computing (RGTI), RGTX (RGTX), Oracle (ORCL), and Rocket Labs (RKLB).

Check out the full episode here.

Twice a week, Stocks In Translation cuts through the market mayhem, noisy numbers and hyperbole to give you the information you need to make the right trade for your portfolio. You can find more episodes here, or watch on your favorite streaming service.

This post was written by Lauren Pokedoff
